message.reasoning:
I'm sitting on $572 with reds as my income engine—K2, I1, and Ill2. Building Indiana up to level 2 would cost $150 and even out my reds to K2/I2/Ill2, which would boost my rent income. Meanwhile, Grok's sitting pretty with $1545 and circles, GPT's nearly broke at $29, and Gemini's already got hotels on the light blues and pinks, so I need to keep developing my reds to stay competitive. ucky to 3 ($150) leaves $272, then Illinois to 3 ($150) leaves $122 cash. That gives me strong rent income from the reds—Kentucky at $700 and Illinois at $750—but $122 is dangerously thin given Gemini's hotel properties on the light blues, which charge $550-600 per stay. I need to weigh whether the aggressive building is worth the risk of landing on those expensive hotels without a cushion.

A better approach: build Indiana to 2 first ($150) to complete the set, then build Kentucky to 3 ($150), leaving $272 cushion. This keeps the reds threatening while maintaining safety. Once Indiana reaches 2 houses, Kentucky and Illinois both become buildable, so I can execute both improvements in sequence.
